references.rule: An absent OPTIONAL dummy can be forwarded to another OPTIONAL dummy, which is then absent, subject to the preceding restrictions.
The optional-argument association rules also apply to intrinsic procedures.
POINTER association status must be defined. Absent TARGET selects the one-argument result. A present array TARGET requires a nonzero matching shape and identical storage in array element order.
Absence cannot be forwarded to a required dummy or through a subobject selector. Pointer actuals have additional restrictions.

implemented_scope: Only whole absent nonpointer OPTIONAL TARGET forwarding is accepted. Absent first POINTER, absent TARGET sections and absent OPTIONAL POINTER TARGET remain rejected. No broader optional-pointer claim is made.
oracle_policy: The main GNU suite compiles the three omission cases but does not count their execution as differential agreement. A separate receipt records GNU output and candidate specification expectations without running undefined-pointer or expired-lifetime programs under GNU.
